headlines.title: China seen doing ‘just enough’ with targeted fiscal support to defend GDP growth
headlines.summary:
China’s finance minister has pledged to roll out incremental and targeted fiscal policies to help achieve leadership’s full-year growth target for the country, following a freshly announced package of supportive measures. However, analysts expect Beijing to stop short of a major stimulus, providing only “just enough” support to meet the target.

headlines.summary_zh:

headlines.title_en: MSCI Emerging Markets stock index rises 1.8%, developing countries currency index up 0.4%
headlines.summary_en: MSCI's emerging markets stock index rose 1.8%, and the developing-nation currency index rose 0.4%. Brazilian stocks posted their best single-day performance since 2020 as investors focused on presidential candidate Bolsonaro leading President Lula in the first round of the election. The Bovespa index in Sao Paulo closed up 7.70% at 207,000 points, with Rio de Janeiro surging sharply early and stabilizing at high levels for most of the session. The Brazilian real rose 4.21% against the dollar to 4.9931 reais, holding broadly at high levels intraday and trading persistently around 4.99 reais.

headlines.title: 全球纯燃油车新车销量占比首次跌破50%
headlines.summary: Mobility Global最新数据显示，2026年上半年，纯汽油车型占全球新车销量的49%，这是历史上纯汽油车销量占比首次跌破五成，且较2021年的73%大幅下降了24个百分点。Mobility Global是一家汽车数据机构，前身为标普全球汽车（S&P Global Mobility），今年从标普全球集团分拆独立。该机构数据显示，今年上半年，纯汽油车销量同比下降10%，至2025万辆。仅一年之内，其市场份额就下滑3个百分点，从52%降至49%。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: Global share of new pure gasoline vehicle sales falls below 50% for the first time
headlines.summary_en: Latest data from Mobility Global shows that in the first half of 2026, pure gasoline vehicles accounted for 49% of global new car sales, the first time in history that the share of pure gasoline vehicles fell below 50%, and a sharp decline of 24 percentage points from 73% in 2021. Mobility Global is an automotive data firm formerly known as S&P Global Mobility, which was spun off from S&P Global Group this year. Its data shows that in the first half of this year, pure gasoline vehicle sales fell 10% year-on-year to 20.25 million units. In just one year, its market share dropped 3 percentage points, from 52% to 49%. (China Fund News)

headlines.title: 国庆假期上海楼市热度不减：新房售楼处“9点不到就有客户来了”，二手房议价空间持续收窄
headlines.summary: 进入国庆黄金周，上海楼市迎来“银十”开门红。不少新盘项目抢抓假期窗口开放展厅、推出专属特价房源吸引客户。叠加天气转晴、假期末尾返沪人流增多，不少新房项目的到访、成交迎来一波小高峰，二手房带看与议价氛围也同步回暖。位于闵行区浦江镇的象屿·天宸雅颂项目，国庆假期售楼处客流热度不减。据项目负责人介绍，国庆期间项目推出特价房活动，房源去化表现较好。截至10月4日，假期累计到访客户接近170组。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai property market heat persists during National Day holiday: new home sales offices see 'customers arriving before 9 am', second-hand home price negotiation space continues to narrow
headlines.summary_en: As the National Day Golden Week began, Shanghai's property market got off to a strong start for the 'Silver October.' Many new projects seized the holiday window to open showrooms and launch exclusive discounted units to attract customers. Combined with clearer weather and more people returning to Shanghai at the end of the holiday, many new home projects saw a small peak in visits and transactions, and the atmosphere for second-hand home viewings and negotiations also warmed in tandem. At the Xiangyu Tianchen Yayue project in Pujiang Town, Minhang District, sales office traffic remained strong during the National Day holiday. According to the project manager, special discounted housing activities were launched during the holiday, and unit sell-through performed well. As of October 4, cumulative customer visits during the holiday approached 170 groups.
